brief: How to launch a product in 7 days from zero audience.

slots.title: FIND PAIN
slots.body: Pick a problem you’ve solved before and validate it with three quick conversations today.

slots.title: PRE-SELL
slots.body: Build a simple checkout page before the product exists and offer a founding-member discount.

slots.title: BUILD FAST
slots.body: Spend 48 hours creating the minimum solution that delivers the promised outcome without fluff.

slots.title: CONTENT
slots.body: Publish five short posts across platforms telling the story behind the product, not the specs.

slots.title: LAUNCH
slots.body: Email every contact, post in relevant communities, and run a small ad to cold traffic.

slots.title: OPTIMIZE
slots.body: Fix the top objection from day-one buyers, raise the price, and automate delivery next.

slots.headline: GO
slots.body: Launch your product this week and prove that audience size is just an excuse.
